notes: Level 3 party vs a young red dragon. We had no business surviving. Brakka held its attention for three rounds while we got the villagers out.
Hadrik dueled the veteran knight, a clearly stronger opponent, and barely won after a long tough fight.
Outnumbered five to one, Kesh held the alley long enough for the others to escape.
The lich was level 15 and we're level 4. Mara put an arrow in its phylactery from 200 feet and it just... ended. Nobody believes it.
lvl 2 vs a CR 8 hill giant. Tib stabbed it in the ankle & got flattened. still counts right?
Selma kept Hadrik alive through the fight with the vampire lord, way above our level, healing him every single round.
Close call. The ogre chieftain nearly killed Oskar twice, but he wrestled it into the river and it drowned.
Against all odds, Ilse talked down the demon prince. We were level 6. It was not supposed to be a social encounter.
Me and Tali vs a whole goblin warband (like 20) in the ravine. Tali shot, I held the choke point. We lived. barely.
Nereth, level 5, counterspelled an archmage's disintegrate. The archmage was so surprised he teleported away.
Tough fight against a higher-level assassin in the dark. Tamsin lost, got stabbed, but she marked him before he vanished.
The wyvern was way out of Rook's league. He and Pudding the boar drove it off anyway, with a lot of luck and a lot of squealing.
Los guardias del duque eran mucho más fuertes que nosotros, pero Beto los mantuvo a raya en el puente hasta que llegaron refuerzos.
